title: EvalMORAAL: Interpretable Chain-of-Thought and LLM-as-Judge Evaluation for Moral Alignment in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents EvalMORAAL, a benchmarking framework specifically designed to evaluate the moral alignment of Large Language Models. It utilizes datasets from the World Values Survey and PEW Global Attitudes Survey to assess model perspectives on various ethical and culturally sensitive topics, including homosexuality, abortion, and religious-influenced social norms.
